To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Here are the details you requested for ticket CP-48213.

1. Terminal model and firmware
The four BX-300 terminals at Embakasi auto-updated from firmware 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 October. The two Mombasa Road terminals remain on 4.1.8, having been offline during the rollout. Their day-shift exports are unaffected.

2. Shift template
The affected staff use NIGHT-8, scheduled from 22:00 to 06:00 at Embakasi.

3. Example
Staff ID T-0417 clocked in at 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October. All times are local Nairobi time.

The export showed:
- 30 October: 2.1 hours REG
- 31 October: 6.1 hours OT15

The expected result is 8.0 hours REG plus 0.2 hours OT15. Payroll rounds durations to the nearest tenth of an hour: the total of 8 hours 13 minutes rounds to 8.2 hours, with the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift coded OT15.

4. Export profile
Payroll CSV v2.

5. When noticed
Kevin first identified the problem on 5 November while reviewing draft October overtime. The affected exports date from about 28 October: shifts crossing midnight are split into two lines, with the after-midnight portion incorrectly coded OT15 rather than REG.

This affects 38 night-shift staff and overstated draft October overtime by approximately KES 212,000. Kevin has held those overtime lines and corrected them manually using raw punches, but this is not sustainable.

Your 4.2.1 release notes promised improved midnight rollover handling; our experience has been the opposite. We need a fix or a clear, reliable workaround before payroll cut-off on 20 November. Kevin, our payroll officer, is copied and will test your proposed solution.

Can Brian, our IT colleague who manages the terminals, safely roll the Embakasi terminals back to 4.1.8 without losing punch data? Please confirm any backup steps and precautions required before he proceeds.

Kind regards,
Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager
Tausi Freight
